headwords: anh chột làm vua xứ mù

flags.why: The example defines the prefix instead of showing it in use.
This is a literary expression rather than an ordinary way to describe being content with one's circumstances.

This remains an everyday expression for estimating roughly, so the rare tag is misleading; see [Từ điển tiếng Việt](https://medialib.qlgd.edu.vn/Uploads/THU_VIEN/shn/1/1124/UserFiles/Tu-Dien-Tieng-Viet-Hoang-Long-thuviensach.vn-b6c5cba7-6d08-4fa4-aae4-6b53ec52276c.pdf).
This is a formal kinship expression that learners would not normally use in casual conversation.
